verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state findings include actionable fix guidance and that users can 'let Qodo apply the fix directly' within the PR review flow (qodo-docs-2, qodo-docs-3), and the Agentic Toolbox/MCP lets agents 'retrieve and resolve review findings' as follow-up actions (qodo-docs-6), confirmed live via MCP endpoint probe (qodo-probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the applied-fix commit flow works reliably in practice (community evidence is about a different product, BugBot switch, not this capability).
